label: Temu
terms_note: Temu seller account (local marketplace sellers on seller.temu.com / seller-eu.temu.com, cross-border on agentseller.temu.com); developer app (app_key / app_secret) on the Partner Platform, reviewed by Temu; seller authorises per store; initial 20 requests / s per app_key; regional gateways; sandbox not confirmed on the pages read.

discovery.auth: api_key + seller authorisation (app_key + app_secret; access_token via manual / callback / in-app authorisation in Seller Center; MD5 sign over common params)
sdks: community markdown mirror of the Partner API docs — https://github.com/opastorello/temu-api-docs (unofficial)

rate_limits: documented per endpoint (not readable from here)

reference.verdict: **Verdict** — has_api: **yes**.Confidence: **high** — official developer documentation opened by the aud
auth: 1. Register a developer app on the Partner Platform → app_key + app_secret (review).
2. Seller authorises in Seller Center: manual (copies the token), callback (code → token via the redirect_uri), or in-app (`/open-platform/client-manage/authorization?appKey=…&redirect_uri=…`).
3. Sign every call with MD5 over the common parameters + app_secret.

endpoints.purpose: create / edit goods, SKUs, images, attributes

reference.limits: Initial 20 requests per second per app_key (search snippet of the docs); per-type limits in the reference. - Partner Platform terms + data security policy; app review. - Seller authorisation per store; regional gateways must match the seller's region.
mcp_sdk: SDK: community markdown mirror of the Partner API docs — https://github.com/opastorello/temu-api-docs (unofficial)

config_fields.name: region
config_fields.help: Gateway of the seller's store: us (United States), eu (Germany, Italy, France, Spain, UK, …) or global (Mexico, Japan, …) → https://openapi-b-{region}.temu.com/openapi/router ('Endpoints and Request Method', Developer Guide).

fields.name: app_key
fields.help: app_key of your Temu Partner Platform app (issued after app review).

fields.name: app_secret
fields.help: app_secret of the same app; signs every call: upper(MD5(app_secret + sorted key+value of all body fields + app_secret)). Never sent on the wire.

fields.name: access_token
fields.help: The store's access_token, issued when the seller authorises your app in Seller Center (manual authorisation copies it; 'can be obtained from Seller Center', Common Parameters). Check its expiry with `me` (result.expiredTime).

me.note: bg.open.accesstoken.info.get: the token's mallId, mallType (1 semi-managed, 100 local), expiredTime (epoch seconds) and apiScopeList (the APIs this token may call).

list_orders.note: bg.order.list.v2.get: parent orders (PO-…) newest first, each with orderList[] (orderSn, goodsId, skuId, quantity, orderStatus) in `raw`. `status`: pending, unshipped (awaiting shipment), canceled, shipped, received or all. `since` (ISO date/datetime) filters by creation time (createAfter; createBefore is set far in the future because the API needs both). Parent status codes: 1 pending, 2 awaiting shipment, 3 canceled, 4 shipped, 5 received, 41 partially shipped, 51 partially received. `created_at` is epoch seconds; amounts come from bg.order.amount.query (not mapped).

set_inventory.note: bg.local.goods.stock.edit (local-mall stores): sets SKU `sku` (Temu skuId) of goods `listing_id` (goodsId) to exactly `quantity` (skuStockTargetList). Both ids are required and numeric; per-SKU results are in raw.skuStockEditStatusInfoList.

not_offered.create_listing: bg.local.goods.add / temu.local.goods.v3.add (https://partner-us.temu.com/documentation?menu_code=645953235e964a23a0320b249ba865af) require a leaf category id, category-specific properties, a shipping template and SKU spec ids obtained from bg.local.goods.cats.get / bg.local.goods.spec.id.get; the vocabulary's create_listing has none of these inputs.
not_offered.update_listing: Prices change only through bg.local.goods.priceorder.change.sku.price, which needs per-SKU 'skuId' (required) and 'newSupplierPrice {amount, currency}' and 'Support merchants within the white list' (https://partner-us.temu.com/documentation?menu_code=dbf95d09e514491f8685013824cecc76); update_listing has no SKU or currency input.
not_offered.mark_shipped: bg.logistics.shipment.v2.confirm (https://partner-us.temu.com/documentation?menu_code=70cca1a3690044eaae4a28de6de76bb1) requires, per package, 'selfShippingWarehouseId' (required) and 'orderSendInfoList' with each child 'orderSn' and 'quantity' (required) besides the carrierId and trackingNumber; mark_shipped only has order_id, carrier and tracking_number.

adapter.terms: Temu Partner Platform: every call is POST https://openapi-b-{us|eu|global}.temu.com/openapi/router with the common parameters (type, app_key, access_token, data_type JSON, timestamp in seconds within ±300 s) and the API's own parameters in one JSON body, signed with sign = upper(MD5(app_secret + sorted key+value + app_secret)) inserted into that body ('Signature Method for API request', https://partner-us.temu.com/documentation?menu_code=4a821c90d06442a09e061b0d4316fbf3).

live_check.notes: requires app_key, app_secret, access_token, region; started, listed tools and answered a clean auth_error naming the variables
